CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_ministry_member_local_id()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  select local_id into new.local_id from public.profiles where id = new.profile_id;
  return new;
end $function$
